audit.whatIsWrong: Labelled EVEN at 6/10 on a 53.94% Emerald+ win rate over 710 games, and three chart rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the page's own whys text.
audit.why: Malphite stacks armour and Gragas is full magic damage; the page says so itself in early, mid and spikes[0]. The packet chart reads Skill / Gragas / Skill / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas, and the whys agree with it: whys[2] literally opens 'Around levels 3-5 the lane is even-ish skill' while win[2] said Gragas, and whys[3]/whys[4] describe trades 'he can't win' and 'a full all-in on a champ with zero magic resist' while win[3]/win[4] said Skill.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN to FAV, diffRating 6/10 to 4/10, tone to green, and the chart rows aligned to the packet as one atomic group with ratings raised on the Gragas stages. carryRating stays 7/10 — his ult is a real teamfight threat even in a lane he loses.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike rows were generic ('Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright') and never used the range or cooldown numbers that make them actionable.
audit.why: Barrel Roll reaches 850; Seismic Shard reaches 625 on a flat 8s at every rank. That gap is the entire level-1 stage and it was unstated. Thunderclap is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8 and Ground Slam a flat 7s, so his chip is on short timers while your all-in runs off a 12-14s Body Slam and a 100/85/70 Cask.
audit.corrected: phases[0].why now states 850 vs 625, phases[2].why the 8s Shard, phases[4].why the level-6 all-in sequence, and breakdown.cooldowns the 130s ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: Granite Shield is absent from the entire page. It absorbs up to 10% of his maximum Health and recharges after he goes a few seconds without being hit.
audit.why: This is the most useful mechanical fact in the matchup for a poke champion and it appears nowhere in tldr, phases, breakdowns, dos, donts or wants. Every Barrel Roll strips it, and if you break contact before committing it comes back, so the correct pattern is barrel first, then engage — not engage into a free 10%-max-HP buffer. It also reframes his lane plan: disengaging to recharge the shield is what he wants.
audit.corrected: Granite Shield written into phases[0].why, breakdown.cooldowns and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The late text tells you to 'Save your Explosive Cask to knock him off your team or peel that engage'. Whether Cask's knockback can actually displace Malphite during Unstoppable Force is not answerable from the kit file.
audit.why: The kit's R entry carries projectile, dash and knockup flags but no unstoppable flag, and Riot's description says only that he launches himself and knocks enemies into the air. Displacement immunity during the ult is exactly the kind of thing the kit file does not record. I left the advice untouched rather than assert either way.
